text.areas-hint-project.ts: writes a throwaway project on disk with a chosen number of records and features, and optionally an areas file
text.updater-world.ts: builds the updater with a stub network, a stub native updater, manual timers and a chosen activity, and records its requests, logs and published notices
text.auth-ipc-world.ts: registers the account channels on a fake IPC with one trusted window, so a test can call each channel and read every reply and push
text.auth-window.ts: installs a window.ccmws made of the real account handlers over a fake provider server, so renderer tests run against true replies and record the calls
text.auth-world.ts: builds an auth service on a temp folder with a fake clock, an AES fake cipher that can lock or fail, fake provider drivers that burn used refresh tokens, and the detected host, env-file names and environment a project sees
text.credential-world.ts: starts the real credential server over a fake account store in a temp folder, with a project, a symlink to it and a folder outside it, and asks it raw lines or typed requests
text.credential-world.ts gotcha: The socket lives in a short temp path because Unix socket paths are limited in length.
text.fake-lantern.ts: serves a scripted JSON reply on a real socket and records each request, standing in for the running app
text.fake-host.ts: scripted router that answers requests by method and URL prefix and records each call, served as an in-process fetch or as a local HTTP server keyed by host, with optional reply headers
text.fake-host.ts gotcha: The server form takes the host from the first path segment, so a redirecting preload must put it there.
text.redirect-fetch.mjs: preload that sends every fetch of a spawned script to the local fake host, keeping the original host in the path
text.skill-runner.ts: runs an integration skill's CLI in-process with injected environment, fetch and folder, never contacting a real Lantern, and returns its exit code and output, and builds a git repo with a bare origin for its pull request commands
text.fake-providers.ts: local HTTP server that plays GitHub, Bitbucket and Jira for the token check: accepted accounts per header, scripted failures, hangs and redirects, and a record of each request
text.fake-tokens.ts: fake GitHub and Atlassian tokens assembled at run time in the real token shapes, so no secret-shaped literal sits in the test sources
text.fake-providers.ts gotcha: It never follows a redirect and never sees the real hosts: tests point the endpoints table at it.
text.diagnostics-world.ts: a Diagnostics service on a temporary folder with a controllable clock, report context and entry builder for the Diagnostics tests
text.diff-text.ts: builders for whole-file, new-file and removed-file diff text
text.fake-bitbucket.ts: local HTTP server that answers pull request lookups with scripted states, delays and redirects and records each request
text.fake-claude.ts: installs a stand-in claude executable that records its arguments, folder and stdin and answers with text, an error, an empty or unreadable reply, a reply the test supplies, a hang, a stream-json run that succeeds or fails with permission denials, or a scripted Lantern map run, as the test chooses
text.fake-lantern-agent.mjs: Plays the model of a Lantern map run for the stand-in claude: maps a fixture project, does or skips the areas step, can show a refused worker call, and answers the blind lookup's one-shot calls
text.fake-github.ts: local HTTP server that answers GitHub pull request lookups with scripted states, status codes, rate-limit headers and delays and records each request and its headers
text.git-repo.ts: real git repository builders, merge and squash helpers and PR record writer for tests
text.git-repo.ts gotcha: prRecord writes the lantern-pr 1 format by hand, so a format change must be mirrored here
text.host-world.ts: git project whose origin is a Bitbucket or GitHub URL and whose pull request branches are pushed, plus fixed test credentials
text.lantern-flow-cases.ts: a valid flow as record lines and as stories, flows whose steps point at files, every malformed flow or reference with the message it must raise, and the limits of a flow, shared by the parser, parity and view tests
text.lantern-macro-areas-fixture.ts: builds a ten-feature project on disk with two platforms, outside systems, a four-area tree and area texts, for the areas derivation tests
text.lantern-macro-areas-payload.ts: builds the macro payload with areas for the pinned fixture map and four areas over its features, with one feature left to assign, for the view and layout tests and the end-to-end harness
text.lantern-macro-fixture.ts: derives the macro view and the block of every file of the pinned fixture map for tests, and reads this repo's feature texts and the fixture's pull request records
text.lantern-areas-gate-fixtures.ts: an invented sixteen-feature shop snapshot with a good and a layer-named grouping, a coupled eight-feature project, and runners for areas.mjs
text.lantern-areas-fixtures.ts: a small invented project of eight features, a valid four-area tree and builders for trees of any size, for the areas tests
text.lantern-vocab-fixtures.ts: three small invented maps, a tidy one, one with platform-named, vendor-named, duplicate and library-like names, and one with no platforms or systems list, for the vocabulary tests
text.macro-foundation-world.ts: Builds a small synthetic project with invented platforms (a web one, a backend one, a bot and an infrastructure one), two areas and a feature left to assign, and derives its areas and Macro payload with the real derivation.
text.macro-uses-world.ts: Builds a small synthetic project with a backend and two bots of one kind, one keeping its people code in files of its own and the other calling the same code from files under one umbrella feature, and derives its Macro payload with the real derivation.
text.macro-lab-world.ts: Generates the invented Orchard Market project (six areas, eighteen features, five platforms with an infrastructure one and two chat bots, a foundation band, a feature left to assign, a pull request across three areas with its Flow, outside systems with different counts and some talked to by the foundation) and derives its Macro payload with the real derivation.
text.lantern-plan-world.ts: builds a throwaway project from the shared plan fixtures, with or without a remote, and runs the plan and sync scripts against it for the plan tests
text.lantern-vocab-project.ts: writes a synthetic project with its map, features, platforms, systems list and areas to a temp folder, runs the lantern-setup scripts on it and snapshots its .lantern files
text.source-blocks.ts: finds a function body, an IPC handler's arguments or every occurrence of a call inside a source file by matching brackets while skipping strings, template literals and comments, so wiring tests check where a call sits rather than counting matches
text.lantern-map.ts: builders for map nodes, whole maps (with their plans and unreadable plan files) and PR records
text.lantern-sections.ts: section fixtures (RBAC, states) and a mount helper for the map view
text.macro-sizes-world.ts: Generates a small (4 areas, 8 features) and a large (7 areas, 24 features) invented project and derives their Macro payloads with the real derivation.
text.memory-fixtures.ts: reads the recorded ps, top, lsof and memory_pressure text and fakes the command runner
text.run-cost-fixture.ts: writes a small synthetic delegate and reviewer transcript directory with tool results of known sizes
text.macroview-world.ts: generates a Macro payload with a chosen number of areas and features, files and links, without the derivation
text.macroview-host.ts: Sizes the areas map's pane in jsdom and gives host tests the calls they need: find a shape by key, click it, double-click it, list the shapes with a flag and read its label.
text.setup-project.ts: builds a 63-file throwaway project and maps chosen files in the .lantern format
text.comment-body.ts: builds file and diff code bodies and a text selection over their lines for the comment tests
text.pr-rows.ts: Opens a changed file from the pull request list and switches the review pane between file and diff for tests
